# OMNIRA AI Platform

> OMNIRA is a next-generation, all-in-one AI platform providing free access to leading LLMs, reasoning models, and AI creative studios.

## Overview
- **Name**: OMNIRA
- **Website**: https://omnira-chat.vercel.app/
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence Platform & Multi-Model Chat Studio
- **Pricing**: Free Online Access

## Core Features & AI Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Model Chat Studio
OMNIRA supports real-time chat and reasoning across top AI models:
- **OMNIRA (GPT-4o)**: High-intelligence reasoning for complex coding, analysis, and conversation.
- **Claude 3.5 Sonnet**: State-of-the-art programming, text generation, and logical analysis.
- **Gemini 1.5 Flash**: Fast multimodal document processing and context analysis.
- **DeepSeek R1**: Mathematical chain-of-thought step-by-step problem solving.
- **Grok 2**: Real-time knowledge synthesis and interactive Q&A.
- **Perplexity Sonar**: Live web search with inline web citations.

### 2. Specialized AI Studios
- **Code Studio**: Real-time code execution, syntax highlighting, multi-language editing, and debugging.
- **Doc Studio**: AI document editor, summary generation, markdown preview, and text formatting.
- **Math Studio**: Step-by-step LaTeX math solver and equation builder.
- **Image / SVG Studio**: Vector graphics generator, sticker design, and photorealistic AI art.
